---
title: "analyze strains/sample and rarefaction by site/city/total"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r}
# Load packages
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(micropan)
library(rprojroot)
library(eoffice)
library(ggdist)

# Load data files
virome_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_virome_abundance_table3.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)
metadata_table <- sprintf(
  "%s/data/wastewater_sample_metadata_table3.tsv", 
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)

virome_dt <- fread(virome_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
meta_dt <- fread(metadata_table, sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

# Remove rows with empty strain values
virome_dt <- virome_dt %>% filter(!is.na(strain) & strain != "")

# Merge virome and metadata
virome_met_dt <- merge(virome_dt, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID")

# Create combined City_Site variable
virome_met_dt$City_Site <- str_c(virome_met_dt$City, ", ", virome_met_dt$Site)

# CNS style color palette
cns_colors <- c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4", "#91D1C2", "#DC0000", "#7E6148", "#B09C85", "#4a1486", "#bdbdbd","#CC79A7")

# Calculate median strains per sample and sort City_Site by median strains in descending order
median_strains <- virome_met_dt %>%
  group_by(sample_ID, City_Site) %>%
  summarise(strains = n_distinct(strain)) %>%
  group_by(City_Site) %>%
  summarise(median_strains = median(strains), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(median_strains))

# Convert City_Site to ordered factor based on median strains
virome_met_dt$City_Site <- factor(virome_met_dt$City_Site, levels = median_strains$City_Site)

# Create raincloud plot with City_Site ordered by median strains
raincloud_plot <- virome_met_dt %>%
  group_by(sample_ID, City_Site) %>%
  summarise(strains = n_distinct(strain), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = City_Site, y = strains, fill = City_Site)) +
  stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5, width = 0.8, justification = -0.35,
    color = NA, alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, size = 1, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = after_stat(y)),
    vjust = 2, color = "black", size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cns_colors) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2, 0.2))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Strains detected per sample"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(raincloud_plot)

# Save raincloud plot as PDF
ggsave(
  raincloud_plot,
  file = sprintf("%s/charts/strains_by_site.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()),
  width = 4,
  height = 6
)

# Save raincloud plot as PPTX
pptx_filename_strains <- sprintf(
  "%s/charts/strains_by_site.pptx",
  find_rstudio_root_file()
)
topptx(raincloud_plot, filename = pptx_filename_strains, height = 6, width = 3.5)

# Prepare data for rarefaction analysis
all_strain_wide <- 
  virome_met_dt %>% 
  group_by(strain, sample_ID) %>%
  summarize(RPKMF = mean(RPKMF)) %>%
  distinct(strain, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strain, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0) %>%
  subset(select = -sample_ID)

# Perform rarefaction analysis for all samples
mat_all_wide <- as.matrix(all_strain_wide)
all_rare <- rarefaction(mat_all_wide, n.perm = 100)
all_rare$avg <- rowMeans(all_rare[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
all_rare$max_g <- apply(all_rare[, -1], 1, max)
all_rare$min_g <- apply(all_rare[, -1], 1, min)
all_rare$type <- "City"
all_rare$subset <- "All"

# Rarefaction for Guangzhou city
GZ_strain_wide <- 
  virome_met_dt %>% 
  filter(City == "Guangzhou") %>%
  group_by(strain, sample_ID) %>%
  summarize(RPKMF = mean(RPKMF)) %>%
  distinct(strain, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strain, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0) %>%
  subset(select = -sample_ID)

mat_GZ_wide <- as.matrix(GZ_strain_wide)
GZ_rare <- rarefaction(mat_GZ_wide, n.perm = 100)
GZ_rare$avg <- rowMeans(GZ_rare[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
GZ_rare$max_g <- apply(GZ_rare[, -1], 1, max)
GZ_rare$min_g <- apply(GZ_rare[, -1], 1, min)
GZ_rare$type <- "City"
GZ_rare$subset <- "Guangzhou"

# Rarefaction for individual sites in Guangzhou
sites <- c("DXL", "HCZ", "RHN", "SLZ", "SY", "ZHGC","LD")
site_rare_list <- list()

for (site in sites) {
  site_data <- 
    virome_met_dt %>% 
    filter(Site == site) %>%
    group_by(strain, sample_ID) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = mean(RPKMF)) %>%
    distinct(strain, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = strain, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0) %>%
    subset(select = -sample_ID)
  
  mat_site_wide <- as.matrix(site_data)
  site_rare <- rarefaction(mat_site_wide, n.perm = 100)
  site_rare$avg <- rowMeans(site_rare[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
  site_rare$max_g <- apply(site_rare[, -1], 1, max)
  site_rare$min_g <- apply(site_rare[, -1], 1, min)
  site_rare$type <- "Site"
  site_rare$subset <- paste("Guangzhou", site, sep = ", ")
  
  site_rare_list[[site]] <- site_rare
}

# Rarefaction for Nanning city and its sites
# Nanning city
NN_strain_wide <- 
  virome_met_dt %>% 
  filter(City == "Nanning") %>%
  group_by(strain, sample_ID) %>%
  summarize(RPKMF = mean(RPKMF)) %>%
  distinct(strain, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = strain, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0) %>%
  subset(select = -sample_ID)

mat_NN_wide <- as.matrix(NN_strain_wide)
NN_rare <- rarefaction(mat_NN_wide, n.perm = 100)
NN_rare$avg <- rowMeans(NN_rare[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
NN_rare$max_g <- apply(NN_rare[, -1], 1, max)
NN_rare$min_g <- apply(NN_rare[, -1], 1, min)
NN_rare$type <- "City"
NN_rare$subset <- "Nanning"

# Nanning sites
nanning_sites <- c("JN", "XXJ", "NPJ")
nanning_site_rare_list <- list()

for (site in nanning_sites) {
  site_data <- 
    virome_met_dt %>% 
    filter(City == "Nanning" & Site == site) %>%
    group_by(strain, sample_ID) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = mean(RPKMF)) %>%
    distinct(strain, sample_ID, RPKMF) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = strain, values_from = RPKMF, values_fill = 0) %>%
    subset(select = -sample_ID)
  
  mat_site_wide <- as.matrix(site_data)
  site_rare <- rarefaction(mat_site_wide, n.perm = 100)
  site_rare$avg <- rowMeans(site_rare[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
  site_rare$max_g <- apply(site_rare[, -1], 1, max)
  site_rare$min_g <- apply(site_rare[, -1], 1, min)
  site_rare$type <- "Site"
  site_rare$subset <- paste("Nanning", site, sep = ", ")
  
  nanning_site_rare_list[[site]] <- site_rare
}

# Combine all rarefaction results
multi_rare <- rbind(
  all_rare, GZ_rare, 
  do.call(rbind, site_rare_list),
  NN_rare, 
  do.call(rbind, nanning_site_rare_list)
)

# Create rarefaction plot
rarefaction_plot <- ggplot(multi_rare, aes(x = Genome, y = avg)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = Genome, ymin = min_g, ymax = max_g, fill = subset), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(x = Genome, y = avg, col = subset), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.95) +
  xlab("WWTP Samples Analyzed") + 
  ylab("Number of Unique Strains Detected") +
  facet_wrap(vars(type), nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = cns_colors) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = cns_colors) +  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

print(rarefaction_plot)

# Save rarefaction plot as PDF
ggsave(sprintf("%s/charts/strain_rarefaction_city_site1.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file()), width = 9, height = 6)

# Save rarefaction plot as PPTX
pptx_filename_rarefaction <- sprintf("%s/charts/strain_rarefaction_city_site1.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(rarefaction_plot, filename = pptx_filename_rarefaction, height = 6, width = 9) 
```
